instruction: Candid athletic photograph, full shot. In a dojo with a dark wooden wall, the man in the white gi (R1) on the left grapples with the man in the grey gi (R2) on the right. R1 is bent forward with his back to the camera. R2 stands facing him, placing his right hand on R1's back and gripping R1's sleeve with his left hand. Warm indoor lighting illuminates the black mat and a potted plant in the background.
